steps.title: Is Your openFDA Data Current?
steps.body: FDA now publishes adverse event reports in real time, while openFDA still updates quarterly. Here is how to work with that gap.

steps.title: Live Freshness Check
steps.body: This panel asks openFDA how current its data is each time the page opens.

steps.title: Search The Guide
steps.body: Find any field or rule. Try searching for drugcharacterization or last_updated.

steps.title: Light Or Dark
steps.body: Switch between dark and light mode here. Your choice is remembered on this device.
